analyst.text: Charlotte blew an 18-point lead and lost in overtime at the Lakers after Charles Lee kept Brandon Miller and Coby White out of overtime because of minutes limits, a call fans criticised; Grayson Allen has concussion-like symptoms. Atlanta are flying after handing Oklahoma City its first home loss, but are thin at point guard with CJ McCollum out at least four weeks and face Detroit next. The angle leans towards Atlanta, with a small letdown risk.
